analytic_contract.units: Work in gauge-invariant linear number-count convention with conformal Hcal=aH and c_light=299792.458 km/s exact SI speed conversion; dimensionless LOS V=v_phys/c_light; E21 Cv original (km/s) Mpc^3, CU=Cv/c_light Mpc^3. No mixing Euler conformal time derivative with physical km/s without this normalization.
analytic_contract.local_number_count_subset: Delta_loc,a=B_a V_a,LOS +(V'_a,LOS +partial_LOS Psi_tot)/Hcal, plus the separate STANDARD Kaiser -partial_LOS V_a,LOS/Hcal and other number-count potential/lensing/selection terms not modeled here.
analytic_contract.B_coefficient: In the chosen Bonvin/Lepori et al. convention, B_a=1-Hcal'/Hcal^2+(5 s_a-2)/(r Hcal)-5 s_a+f_evo,a. Consequently D_a=B_a-1. This is convention-specific; do not transplant to other s/f_evo definitions without translating.
analytic_contract.euler_residual: E_a=V'_a,LOS+Hcal V_a,LOS+partial_LOS Psi_tot; Delta_loc,a=D_a V_a,LOS+E_a/Hcal by algebra. Psi_tot INCLUDES neutrino wake potential if wake gravity is represented in metric.
analytic_contract.neutrino_induced_decomposition: For linear signed wind response if delta V_a=beta_a U_rel, delta E_a/Hcal=epsilon_a U_rel, and separately physical LOS selection delta Delta_sel,a=s_a,wind U_rel (avoid confusing with conventional magnification s_a), define d_a=D_a beta_a+epsilon_a+s_a,wind and original E21 km/s coefficient c_a^E21=d_a/c_light.
analytic_contract.two_tracer_odd: Original P_delta,v_km_s=+i mu Cv,F gives Im P_LE=mu (A_L d_E-A_E d_L) Cv,F/c_light, ONLY if all coefficient/model assumptions apply and other complex GR/selection baseline separately modeled.
analytic_contract.metric_and_double_count: If each tracer follows geodesic of the FULL Psi_tot (point-source large-scale Euler limit) E_a=0, even with nonzero Psi_wake and changed V_a. If Psi_tot=Psi_bg+Psi_wake, E_bg=V'+Hcal V+partial Psi_bg=E_tot-partial Psi_wake. Inserting E_bg as independent wake force while also retaining full Psi_tot double counts. A coarse-grained halo COM residual requires an actual finite-size, environment or bias derivation and is not an equivalence-principle violation claim by itself.
analytic_contract.null_and_scope: Neither total-metric Euler residual=0 nor E21 even-sector degeneracy entails all observed odd=0: Doppler D_a deltaV and other metric/selection terms remain. Conversely beta !=0 does not imply chi !=0, and pure Kaiser velocity derivative produces even mu^2 in symmetric plane-parallel limit.
analytic_contract.missing_physics: Neither physical Psi_wake(t) matching E8 original F states and high-z host profiles, nor independently derived beta_a,epsilon_a,s_a,wind, D_a for exact original .9<=z<1 tracer selection exist. E17D1 test-source kernels do not provide them.
